findings.evidence: Lines 438-447: `simp only [chartTerm_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inCoordinates, ...]` … `rw [h1, DomainDependentHomSection.tangentHom_apply]` then `rfl`. `chartTerm` is stated with `mvfderiv` (line 95), but the trivialization lemmas produce `mfderiv`.

findings.evidence: Lines 421-427: `rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_extendTrans_refl]; rfl` and `have h := congrArg (fun e : PartialEquiv M E ↦ ⇑e.symm) (...toPartialEquiv_extendTrans_refl I); exact h`.
findings.fix: Close both goals with explicit rewrites, e.g. `funext; simp [coe_extendTrans_refl]` and a `coe_symm_extendTrans_refl` rewrite (see the next finding), instead of `rfl`/`exact h`.
findings.issue: Both side goals of `chartPushforward_eq_pullbackEnd_inChart` are closed by definitional equality. The first uses `rw [coe_extendTrans_refl]; rfl`, relying on `(refl E).symm ∘ f` reducing to `f`. The second uses `exact h` with `h` a `congrArg` over `PartialEquiv`, relying on `⇑ψ.symm` and `⇑ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm` being the same function and on `∘ id` reducing away.

findings.evidence: grep `extendTrans_refl`: only `toPartialEquiv_extendTrans_refl` (1414) and `coe_extendTrans_refl` (1420) exist. The inverse is derived ad hoc at Family/Chart.lean:425-427 and Inhomogeneous/Chart.lean:436-437.
findings.fix: Add `coe_symm_extendTrans_refl : ⇑(c.extendTrans I (Homeomorph.refl E)).symm = (c.extend I).symm` next to `coe_extendTrans_refl` and use it in both places.
findings.issue: The fact that the inverse of `c.extendTrans I (Homeomorph.refl E)` is `(c.extend I).symm` is proved inline twice in this PR, differently each time: `Family/Chart.lean:425` via `congrArg` and `Inhomogeneous/Chart.lean:436` via `simp [extendTrans_symm_apply]`. Only the forward lemma `coe_extendTrans_refl` exists.

summary: Two of the new chart lemmas close goals through undocumented definitional equality (a bare `rfl` after unfolding `inCoordinates`, and an `rfl`/`exact h` on `extendTrans` coercions), and the fact that the inverse of the `extendTrans` chart is `(extChartAt I y).symm` is proved inline twice instead of as a lemma.
